title: Move the codebase domain's tooling and baselines into a top-level codebase/ domain root
summary: Moved tools/code_health, five flat report tools, the code-health hooks, both baselines, the jscpd config and 17 tests into codebase/ and tests/codebase/ with behaviour unchanged (code-health 3617 unchanged, mypy gate 0 new, same test results); added layout guards, orphan-check and test-scope coverage for codebase/, and recorded the M4 soak dates.
